en:
The medical checks are all
finished! Fortunately, it doesn't
look like any of you are going
to turn into beasts!
I'm impressed, Verda. You're a\nscientist at your age?
Heh, something like that, I\nsuppose. Hehehe.

As for you, Henri, based on the
data you gave me, the way you
organize your papers and data
is very similar to that of a
doctor.
At first, I thought you were\nmore like President Onelsen.
Well, I'm just a novice myself.
In the end, I lacked the\nstrength, and I've spent my\ntime up until today in vain.
That's why I just asked Valka\nnot to call me "Doctor."
...Your journey is only just\nbeginning.
As long as you don't lose your\nambition, you'll stop caring\nabout what others call you.
I hope that's true.
By the way, does the\nbeastification virus still remain\nin Daftes?

You predicted that it would
have a high affinity with that
"Burning Death" plague that
ravaged Levarance, didn't you?
Yes, about that... Coro?
Yes! After cross-referencing\nthe data provided by Henri,

I detected something in Daftes'
atmosphere that appears to be
an evolved form of the virus in
question.
note: glossary-waive: 進化 (the natural sense, not the game's character Augment (english.md 7.18))

en: What?! Is that not a problem?!

Please don't worry. This
evolved form is harmless to all
humans currently aboard this
ship.
note: glossary-waive: 進化 (the natural sense, not the game's character Augment (english.md 7.18))

en: I see... You gave me a real\nscare for a moment.

We're still investigating the
connection to the Burning
Death, but we've already
beaten it once, so there's no
need to worry!

We'll need to coordinate with
the science team on Levarance
eventually, but until then, we'll
just have to steadily collect
data using this ship's
equipment.
I'm sorry, but in the meantime...

I understand. I shall do my
humble part to support your
journey, the saviors of the
Binary Star.

Ooh, a truly reliable adult man
has joined the party! I feel like
our journey just got a lot more
stable!

Huh? Oh, n-now wait, I didn't
say the Captain was unreliable!
I would never say such a thing!
Not me!

Aaaah... no, no, no, please don't
look at me like that! It's almost
starting to feel good! Ahhh,
right, right!
Karlyn! Euwin!
...What is it?

Oh... uh, you're that one, right?
The voice we'd occasionally
hear coming from around Evelysse
and the others...?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: I mean, what exactly are you?
I am the GFSS-3214F's\noperation system AI,\nOCAI-880-56 model!
Coro, you're doing this on\npurpose, aren't you?
Everything about you is a joke.
I assume you called us over\nbecause you actually have\nsomething to say.
If you're just trying to tease\nus, I'll crush you.
Y-yes, that's right! Actually, I\nhave some rather serious news\nfor the two of you.
Serious news?

Yes. Actually, the Baschen
Empire has launched a
large-scale attack on the
Kingdom of Rubarika.

Baschen forces have already
pushed deep across the
border, and the capital of
Rubarika is in grave danger.
What!?
What...
WHAT DO YOU\nMEANNNNNNNNNNN!?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> This map shows the
movement of the battlefield
right up until I received the
transmission from Onelsen.
Baschen's speed and scale of\ninvasion are incredible.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I've never seen an
offensive on this scale before.
To pull something like this off,
they would have needed
months of preparation.
But I've never heard of any\nsuch plan.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...It doesn't help anyone\nif you keep secrets!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> At a time like this, I\nhave no reason to hide\nanything from you.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> ...Really?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Besides, even when we\nBeast Witches gave it our all in\nthe past,

we could barely push the front
line forward because of
Rubarika's messenger light
arrows.
In this Holy Land War, though I\nhated to admit it, Rubarika's\npower surpassed Baschen's.

Baschen shouldn't have the
power to overwhelm Rubarika
across such a wide area in
such a short time.

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Actually, it seems that
the political upheaval in the
Baschen Imperial Capital is
heavily involved in this
large-scale offensive.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> A political upheaval?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> This is just a guess, but...

It's possible that the Baschen
Emperor was sent somewhere
else, just like what happened
to Evelysse and the others.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Euwin</font> What!?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> I couldn't detect any biological signatures other than Lady Evelysse's group within a 50km radius of my starship, but...
note: the engine's text (gemma-4-31B-it/qat-UD-Q4_K_XL/v2+story-v1/llama.cpp-b11443/t0) with the M2 names Lady Leash / Lady Carlin as the glossary has them now (Lady Eve: Global's Eve; Lady Karlyn); name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Lady Eve -> Lady Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Regardless, I get the
feeling that something went
down in the Imperial Capital
while the Emperor was away.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I bet the Crown Prince\nseized power.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> The Crown Prince?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Yes. An even bigger\nhawk than the Emperor himself.

He's always saying that simply
winning the Holy War isn't
enough―that Rubarika itself
must be annihilated...
Naturally, he's not the type to\nbe picky about the means used\nto achieve his goals.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Ugh... that's the worst.

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Additionally, I have
confirmed that the majority of
the "Beasts of Baschen"
deployed on the battlefield this
time are of that specific
beast-man type.
This footage shows a few of\nthem.

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Exactly. No matter how
powerful the light arrows are,
they're meaningless if they
don't hit.
Beast-man type Thornite are\nincredibly fast and strong.

There were many instances
where the Rubarika soldiers,
who are inferior in individual
skill, were forced to retreat
because they couldn't land
their new light arrows on the
"Beasts."
...Can't we use this ship to\nintervene in the war?
We have to stop the Beast\nWitches... those girls...

Huh? What are you talking
about? You're on Baschen's
side, aren't you? This should
be exactly what you want...
I never heard about this!!
W-what's with the sudden\nshouting...?
I don't need to understand\nyour strange technology to\nknow!
Beast-man "Beasts"... no matter\nhow you look at it...
They are likely... kin of my\npeople from Daftes.
What... does that mean?
It's obvious by now... every\n"beast" we summoned came\nfrom Daftes.
Isn't that right, you two little\nmarbles over there!
D-did you just call us marbles!?
...While we are still in the\nverification stage, we lack any\nevidence to deny it.

Optically speaking, the
creatures inhabiting Daftes and
the Thornite used by Karlyn
Kayson show an extremely high
rate of similarity.
If the beastmen of Daftes, Lady Karlyn's "beasts,"
note: the engine's text (gemma-4-31B-it/qat-UD-Q4_K_XL/v2+story-v1/llama.cpp-b11443/t0) with the M2 names Lady Leash / Lady Carlin as the glossary has them now (Lady Eve: Global's Eve; Lady Karlyn)

en: and the Thornite mentioned by Lady Evelysse and the others are all the same thing,

en:
then it's highly probable that
these beastmen were
developed as high-spec
biological weapons...
I am a soldier! I kill the enemy!\nNo matter what means I have\nto use!

But... but that doesn't mean
I've fallen so low that I'd
manipulate innocent people and
hide in their shadows!!
Baschen, how can you just let\nthis happen!
Now, calm down.

Baschen's people don't even
know humans live in Daftes, so
you don't need to worry so
much...
I'm not so heartless that I can\nsay that in front of Henri!!
You need not trouble yourself.

Nearly 30,000 years have
passed since civilization was
lost. It is not hard to imagine
that humans have long since
returned to the wild, their
ecology no different from that
of beasts.
That is why...
My family was killed by\nRubarika soldiers on the front\nlines of the Holy Land War!
It was a small fishing village on\nthe coast.

Rubarika's analysts decided it
was too close to the waters
where the Holy Land Asyl
might surface, and that was
the only reason.
Huh? Surface...?
But later, I found out that\nBaschen's side was aware of\nRubarika's movements, and...

But later, I learned that
Baschen had sensed Rubarika's
movements and deliberately
abandoned the village just to
gauge the true strength of the
Rubarikan navy...
Even so, why would they leave\nyou to someone like the Beast\nWitch...?

Because Lord Givel discovered
me... The Baschen army was
obedient to me, for I could
wield the Beast Witch's powers
better than anyone.
Lord Givel is an agent of\nDaftes. He isn't a true\nBaschen.

That's why I followed him. He
gave me power. The power to
make both Baschen and
Rubarika submit...
But for it to end up... like this...
I never once wondered where\nthe "Beasts" actually came\nfrom...

If the people of Onelsen were
summoned by chance... if there
truly is a place where people
live at the edge of the sky...
Then by some mistake, calling\nmyself the "Beast," I will one\nday... once again...
Karlyn...
...Karlyn, that's...
No, I...
Karlyn, may I ask you\nsomething?
Now, this might be a bit rude,\nas it's not exactly related to\nyour troubles.
...What?

You just mentioned that the
Holy Land "surfaces," didn't
you? Is the Holy Land Asyl not
located in one specific place?
Huh? What are you talking...
Oh, did we not mention it? The\nHoly Land Asyl usually rests at\nthe bottom of the ocean.
The bottom of the ocean!?
Oh, did I not mention it? The\nHoly Land of Asyl usually rests\nat the bottom of the ocean.
The bottom of the ocean!?
That's right. The Moonshadow\nLadder doesn't always descend\nin the same spot.

Since the Holy Land of Asyl
appears wherever the ladder
descends, it doesn't always
appear in the same place
either.

May I ask something? Based
on the name, am I correct in
assuming the Moonshadow
Ladder is a massive shadow
connecting the satellite to the
planet's surface?
Yes. There are many paintings\nin Rubarika that depict it that\nway.

Hmm. If the ladder is the
shadow of a solar or lunar
eclipse, it seems the area
would be quite narrow.
Assuming the "Moonshadow\nLadder" is indeed the shadow\nof a solar eclipse,

Then the observable locations
would certainly change based
on the rotation and revolution
of the planet and satellite, as
well as the axial tilt.
And in this case, the point\nwhere the shadow falls is\nalways over the sea.
So that's why the old\nbattlefields of the Holy War\nwere all along the coastlines...

But the Holy Land is at the
bottom of the sea? And it
rises with every eclipse? Is
that even natural...?
I mean, even if you ask me if\nit's "natural," it's just how it's\nalways been...
...No, that's exactly where we're\nwrong.
Eu?
It's always been that way, "It's\nnatural," "That's just how it is."

Because those ideas are
rooted in everyone involved in
the Holy Land War, we've just
kept repeating the same cycle.
Yes, the Holy Land Asyl is on\nan island that rises from the\nbottom of the sea.
You've both heard about it,\nright, Welch, Karlyn?

Tides alone can't possibly
explain it, and don't you think
it's strange that the location
where it appears changes so
drastically?
Have you ever heard of any\nother island like that?

There's a cause. Looking down
from the vastness of the world,
it's clearly abnormal. There's
something about this Holy
Land Asyl.
A human... will?
No way, an island rising and\nsinking because of someone's\nwill?
When you're shown a world this\nvast, nothing seems impossible.\nTika is a perfect example.
Huh?

Tika, you mentioned it earlier,
didn't you? That the old
battlefields of the Holy War are
all along the coast.
Y-yeah.
A child like Tika knows about\nmultiple battlefields from the\nHoly War. Which means...
Rubarika and Baschen must be\npeaceful in Tika's time. Tika is\nfrom the "future"...
You came from far beyond\ntomorrow, didn't you!?
The Holy War isn't happening in\nthe era Tika was born into.
That means the Holy War\nended before Tika was even\nborn.
In a "future" beyond our own.
Otherwise, Tika―who says\nshe's from the future―wouldn't\nbe here.
Big brother Euwin...

Welch, Karlyn, and I have seen
the wider world, and yet here
we are, able to coexist without
fighting.

I believe this is the beginning
of the end for the Holy Land
War between Rubarika and
Baschen, a conflict that has
raged for hundreds of years.

The "Messenger's Light Arrow"
and the "Beast of Baschen"
aren't miracles or anything of
the sort.
They can be explained by the\nlogic of the wider world―logic\nwe simply didn't know about.
There was no such thing as a\n"Messenger of Daftes" in\nDaftes.

The Holy Land War was born
from people making
assumptions about things they
didn't understand.
It's a war where not a single\nperson fighting actually knows\nthe truth.

If we leave the unknown as it
is, we... Daftine... will never
reach the future where Tika
exists.
Captain, Evelysse, Verda,
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Valka, Henri.
Coro, Rekoro, will you lend me\nyour strength?
With your incredible,\nmysterious powers,

I want you to use those
incredible, mysterious powers
of yours to uncover the truth
about the Holy Land of Asyl―a
truth that has remained hidden
from us.

C-Captain, this is getting way
too out of hand for a simple
Uncharted Planet
Protection―GABU!!
Be silent, Coro. This is no\nlonger a problem for Daftine\nalone.
It is a matter that concerns\nDaftes and Levarance as well.

Considering how the
summoning sigil arts Givel
bestowed upon the Beast
Witches affected Daftes
across the cosmos,
there is no guarantee that the\npeople of Levarance won't be\ndragged into this.
We can no longer simply tuck\nour tails and flee from Daftine.
Not for the sake of galactic\npeace, and certainly not for\nthe sake of our comrades.
Wouldn't you agree, Captain?
...To be honest, I saw this\ncoming...
But listen, Euwin, let me make\none thing very clear...!

I know. The responsibility to
stop this war lies with us―the
people of Rubarika and
Baschen.
I swear that we will never\nsimply sit back and rely\nentirely on your strength.
....................Right. ...Well then,\nshall we go?
Why is this taking so long? You\nall got here so quickly!

Once we arrive at Daftine,
there is an extremely high
probability that we will enter a
combat zone.

During the journey to Daftes,
everyone's equipment was
damaged and their stamina
exhausted. If we do not
recover these, the likelihood of
mission failure increases.
Coro and Sister Verda both\nsaid they wanted two days for\nrepairs and treatment.
Sister Karlyn, why don't you\nrest for now too?
...I just can't bring myself to do\nthat.
Sister Karlyn...
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> ...She seems agitated.\nThat will hinder the efficiency\nof the rest period.
<font color=blue>Henri</font> It's only natural. I feel the\nsame way, and you all are in a\nstate of great confusion.

Especially her; the feeling of
being betrayed by the
homeland she believed in must
be strong.
For now, we have no choice\nbut to leave her be.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> As a life pod AI, it is\npathetic that I am forced to\nchoose the option of "neglect."
<font color=blue>Henri</font> It happens.

It's only natural for Karlyn,
Euwin, and Welch to feel some
mental strain when they think
of their homelands.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Even so, I cannot\nfathom Evelysse's reaction.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: I understand that she wishes\nfor peace in Daftine from a\nhumanitarian perspective.

But she should have no direct
stake in Daftine's political
situation, yet she has remained
locked in her room since that
conversation.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> I wonder if Evelysse\nis okay...

en: <font color=blue>Henri</font> She is likely dwelling on\nwhat Karlyn and Verda said.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Huh?

<font color=blue>Henri</font> Karlyn, though she didn't
know at the time, summoned
my kin against their will and
forced them to fight on the
battlefield.
Karlyn was deeply pained by\nthis, feeling that she had\ntrampled upon human dignity.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Oh...

<font color=blue>Henri</font> Evelysse is likely asking
herself where she stands in all
of this, and she cannot find an
answer.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Tika</font> That can't be...! But, Evelysse\nis...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: ...Likely, there is no one but\nyou who can rouse her spirit.
Go to her.
...Yeah, I will!
...Me too.
You shall stay here and lecture\nme on the history of Daftine.
B-but!
Spare the rod and spoil the\nchild.

Respecting their judgment and
letting them gain experience
interacting with others on their
own is also a form of "parental
love."
This is by no means "neglect."
...Humans are still so\nincomprehensible.
Evelysse...? Are you\nokay?
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Big sister Eve -> Evelysse (Global drops お姉ちゃん), the user's decision; the honorific dropped (Global's practice) is a rewording beyond the name: agent row, needs a person's review

en: Oh, Tika.
Is everything alright?
I suppose. I'm just... a little\ntired.
...Is it about Henri's\ncompanions?
...Well, I guess it's pretty\nobvious.
What Verda said really got to\nme.
It made me wonder... what I\nactually thought of my\ncompanions.
Summoning them across space\nand time, regardless of their\nown will...
But our companions... they're\nall human.

I've brought them all on a
journey through the cosmos,
across space and time, with no
guarantee that I can even send
them home.
But... it saved me.
What...?
I was saved because you were\nhere, Evelysse.

en: Tika, but still...
Because Evelysse and\nthe others saved Verda, I was...

en: I was able to survive, even\nacross time.
Please, don't deny that...
Right now... you're all I have,\nEvelysse.

en: ...Tika.
Evelysse is someone who\nuses her power to help others.

en: You're not someone who uses\npower to hurt people.

Even Big Sister Karlyn fought
with that power because she
wanted to protect the people
of Baschen...
But that man, Givel...
I felt like he didn't even think\nof humans as people.
He's not like you, Evelysse.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: ...Tika.
That's why we can't... let\nsomeone like him have\nDaftine's future.
I'm relieved that the flight has\nbeen so smooth so far.

Please don't worry. After the
captains left, I performed a
very thorough scan of the
surrounding space.
At the very least, in the vicinity\nof Daftine and Daftes,
there are no hostile starships\nor asteroid belts that we might\naccidentally crash into.
Then why did my own ship\ncrash?
Perhaps it was due to poor\nmaintenance?
Poor maintenance...?
T-That's not it!

But even looking at the data
you gave me, I couldn't find
anything other than the fact
that it took an external
impact...
I said it's not like that!
...Huh?

My father is the one who
maintained that ship! And I've
always taken great care of it!
There's no way it was poor
maintenance!
Don't talk bad about my\nfather's ship! You idiot, Coro!
W-what? Miss Valka?
Now, now, Valka. Coro is simply\nsaying that we shouldn't rule\nout any possibilities.
He's just a bit tactless with his\nwords.
No, I truly meant...
Coro!
...Hmph. I know... I know\nsomething was there...
Coro! Watch your tone! Surely\nyou can manage that much!

Ah... well, um, since we'll be
returning to Daftes anyway,
because of everyone from
Onelsen...
Once the chaos of the Holy\nWar is over, let's go back and\ninvestigate properly, okay...?
Oh, and, um, I'm sorry.
...Fine.
All right! Now that we've\nsettled that, Valka, about the\nHoly Land of Asyl...
Hmm!

...Ah, based on the data
Administrator Koro collected,
the calculations are already
complete.
W-well, this is a bit sudden...
My, my, to throw Coro off like\nthat... Good grief.

<font color=blue>Valka</font> By calculating the
movements of Daftine and the
satellite Mastima, I can narrow
down the approximate area
where the Moonshadow Ladder
will descend.

Then, by overlaying that with
the areas that can be secured
by the naval forces of Rubarika
and Baschen, as inferred from
Administrator Koro's footage...
It looks like this diagram.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> It's wider than I\nexpected. What is the average\ndepth?
<font color=blue>Valka</font> The continental shelf\ndrops off around here, and the\ndepth increases sharply.

Furthermore, there are several
areas that appear to be
oceanic trenches. The deepest
trench reaches a depth of
8,000 meters.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> That is right at the limit\nof where vertebrate organisms\ncan survive.
Coro, can this ship's pressure\nequipment handle a dive into\nthese trenches?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Don't be ridiculous. This\nship isn't equipped for\nunderwater operations.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...I thought as much.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Asyl called it a holy land,\nso there should be a building\nor something there, right?
It's probably not that deep\ndown.
At 8,000 meters, even a steel\nsphere would be crushed flat!

<font color=blue>Valka</font> Administrator Koro, do
your sensors show any
reactions that match the
description?
In the continental shelf area,\nthe depth is likely 300 meters\nat most.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Nothing at all.
...Hmm.
What is it?
...Maybe it's just because\nyou're poorly maintained, Coro?
...Valka, you're actually kind of\npetty, aren't you...!
Haaa... honestly!
I just had a tune-up on Planet\nViret, so there's no way I'm\nmalfunctioning!
Good grief, they're hopeless.

For now, let's get everyone
together and hear their
thoughts... If I leave these two
to talk it out, nothing's ever
going to get solved.
I see... So even with the\nCaptains' technology, they\ncan't determine where Asyl is.
Maybe Coro just didn't\nmaintain the equipment\nproperly?
Not you too, Ms. Welch!! That's\nnot it at all!
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Maybe it's being hidden.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hidden?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> I think someone is hiding it\nwith a power so great that\neven Coro can't find it.
You know, it felt like that\nwhere Ms. Henri and Onelsen\nwere, right?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> True. Unless someone
had the technical skill to crack
the electronic lock, they
wouldn't have known how to
open that door.

<font color=blue>Henri</font> So, whoever hid the Holy
Land of Asyl ensured it would
only reveal itself when the
conditions for the Moonshadow
Ladder's descent were met...
...and otherwise, its existence\nremains completely\nundetectable.

<font color=blue>Evelysse</font> So in the end, we just
have to wait for the ladder to
descend? We can't intervene in
the war like that.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
<font color=blue>Coro</font> I've thought about it, and
since it's called a "Holy Land," I
think it must be at least larger
than the facility where Ms.
Henri and the others were.
I think the methods for\ndisguising something of that\nscale would be quite limited.

For now, we are searching
while considering mechanical
technology, Crest Science, and
even concealment via some
kind of natural phenomenon...
Unfortunately, nothing\nresembling that has triggered\nour sensors at all.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I think the possibility of\nSymbology is low.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Why is that?

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Asyl has been appearing
and disappearing every time
the Moonshadow Ladder
descends for hundreds of
years, right?

There's no way people could be
there constantly, and if it were
Crest Arts, the durability and
remote functionality would
have to be beyond anything
reasonable.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I believe there are
barrier arts in Symbology that
continue to function even after
the caster has left.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> A barrier just stays in\none place to protect what's\ninside.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Besides, once it's
breached, that's it. To restore
it, the caster would have to go
back and recast it.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I see. So if Symbology\nwere being used on Asyl...

It would have to be a spell that
reacts to a Ladder of unknown
descent, causing it to surface
and appear, then sink and
vanish again.
Even a layman like me could\ntell it was complex.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Furthermore, the spell
itself would have to be able to
judge the surrounding
conditions independently of the
caster. Such a Symbol spell is...
It exists.
Right, as if it could possibly...
Huh?

It does exist. A Symbol spell
that activates based on the
surroundings even after the
caster is gone. Around your
neck.
!! That collar... the one that\nman put on me...!
What? A collar put on by a\nman? What's that about?
The collar the masked man put\non you in the dungeons of\nRubarika!

It's true that when Givel's
Symbol spell and mine clashed,
it suddenly broke and a new
symbol flew out!

That masked guy said that if
we didn't do what he said, the
collar would explode and Karlyn
would die.

Doesn't that mean the symbol
inside the collar activates
based on certain conditions,
and then Daftes blasts her
away?

I-I suppose if I'd been thrown
into Daftes all alone, I probably
wouldn't have survived for
long...
...Hm? What is it, Valka?
...I probably would have saved\nyou anyway...
...Definitely!
...Yes, yes. Thank you.
Mm-hmm!
Good grief... but well, it is a\nconvincing theory.
In other words, if we can get a\nhint about such complex sigil\narts from that masked man,
it might actually be useful in\nour search for Asyl.
It may be better than\nsearching for Asyl blindly,
but tracking down that man will\nbe quite a chore in its own\nright.
True, we don't even know who\nhe is or where he's from.
Right. I mean, the way we met\nhim was so random, and he's\njust... way too elusive.

It might be a detour from our
goal of finding the Holy Land of
Asyl, but we still have time
before we have to go back
down the ladder.
I wonder if there's any way we\ncan track that man down\nourselves.
Coro, you saw him once, right?\nCan't you track him?

Unfortunately, it was
impossible. For some reason, I
was unable to attach a
tracking tag to him.

It's as if some kind of
interference wave is blocking
everything except for optical
sight...
I suspect that man is also from\nan advanced planet.
He likely possesses some\nmethod to evade Coro's\ntracking.
Now that you mention it, my\nhammer didn't seem to do a\nthing to him.

A rather crude way to verify it,
but... perhaps he possesses a
defense mechanism based on
advanced civilization, such as
gravity manipulation.

If that's the case, finding him
seems like it'll be difficult. We
have no idea what his objective
even is...
Objective...
Tika?
Um... I just thought of\nsomething...
I hope it isn't anything\ndangerous.
I think it'll be okay. I think we\ncan meet him. The masked\nman.
What do you mean?
Karlyn, Henri, and I will lure him\nout.
If I let myself be captured by\nBaschen's army again... I bet\nhe'll come for me.

I think there are plenty of
people at the front who don't
know what happened at the
Imperial Castle, and since
Karlyn is high-ranking, she
should be able to blend in
easily.

Then I thought maybe Henri
could protect us while
disguised as a "Beast"... what
do you think?
...It's true that he was\nobsessed with Tika, so it\nseems like a good plan, but...
I wonder if Henri's appearance\nafter transforming into a Beast\nwill look suspicious.
If you're talking about the\nglowing spikes, I think it'll be\nfine.
Huh?

To be honest, even we Beast
Witches don't understand the
logic behind the minor
differences between the
"Beasts."
Givel is probably the only one\nwho knows.

If I just say he's a new type of
"Beast," that should be enough
to fool the soldiers at the
front.
But he already let Karlyn\ncapture us once.
If he hears that Tika has been\ncaptured again, will he actually\nbother coming to rescue her?
I think that'll be okay. Karlyn\nwasn't involved in Baschen's\nattack this time, right?

Even so, if they hear I've been
captured on the front lines
again, I think they'll realize
something is fishy.
Hmm... I guess it could work if\nyou put it that way...
I object. I understand that\neach individual circumstance\nmay work in the plan's favor.

However, the fact that Karlyn
and Henri are accompanying
you is entirely separate from
ensuring Tika's safety.
Rekoro is right about that.
Tika, there is no such thing as\na safe place on the front lines\nof a war.

Furthermore, the risk of not
having any members other
than Karlyn and Henri is far
too great.
Tika, you must properly\nconsider...

I know! But if there's a chance
to stop the fighting in my
sisters' homeland, I want to do
this.
I think it's also connected to\nmy time... to the future.
The future...
Besides, if Daftine doesn't find\npeace now, the future me\nmight be in danger.
So Rekoro, please. I want you\nto come with me. I want you to\nfight by my side.
Gu... unununu!

If you're truly set on this, I
don't mind. If this wretched
disease can help bring peace
to Daftine, I will gladly
cooperate.
Gugugu...!
In that case, I'll join in as a\nprisoner too.

That masked man's obsession
with Tika is abnormal. It would
be terrible if he attacked the
two of you by mistake.

If word gets out that the
youngest son of the Rakstar
family was captured as well,
rumors will spread through
Rubarika quickly, and it'll reach
his ears sooner.

I shall descend with you.
Stealth is my specialty. I will
protect Sir Ewin and Lady Tika
without anyone noticing.
With this many people, Tika\nshouldn't be in too much\ndanger, right, Rekoro?
I... I suppose I have... no\nchoice... ununu. For the sake of\nTika's... future safety... gugugu.
Thank you, Rekoro!
Then I'm in too.
I shall join you as well...

Now, now, Captain, Evelysse,
Verda―just wait a second.
There's no point in all of us
crowding in there.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
That Givel guy seemed
obsessed with Evelysse. If too many
of us end up as prisoners,
word might get back to him,
and he might try something.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: Right, Eu?
Huh!? I mean, that's true, but...
With Karlyn, Valka, Henri, and\neven little Eu there, Tika should\nbe in little danger,

While they're doing their best,
wouldn't it be more efficient for
us to keep searching for Asyl
from here using our usual
approach...?
Hey, what's with those looks?

...I think we're just surprised
that a constructive opinion
actually came out of your
mouth.
Do you guys think I'm an idiot\nor something?
You! Don't look away!
...Are you plotting something?\nLike trying to do something\nweird while I'm gone...?
Nope, nothing! I'm not thinking\nabout secretly dismantling\nCoro or this ship!
Did you just say something\nabsolutely terrible?
Nope, nothing at all!
Are you really doing this?\nYou're really, really doing this?
Yeah! Everyone's here, so it'll\nbe okay!
Don't worry, Rekoro. I will\nprotect Tika, no matter what.
Yeah!!
Even a child this small is this\ndetermined. Everyone, steel\nyourselves.

But if Lord Givel makes a
move, the operation is
cancelled regardless of the
situation. Understood, Tika?
I understand!
<font color=blue>Coro</font>: Now then, let's review\nthe outline of the plan to lure\nout the masked man.

First, Karlyn and Henri
descended to the front-line
units and managed to blend in
without raising suspicion.

I was nervous that they might
be found out, but it seems
Baschen's front-line forces are
quite stretched thin.

They appear to be
short-handed due to the
large-scale offensive, so they
were actually welcomed with
open arms.

According to information from
the two of them, a beastman
unit led by the Beast Witch is
planning to charge toward a
village in Rubarika called
Conroy.

<font color=blue>Coro</font>: Tika, along with Rekoro,
Euwin, and Valka, will descend
onto that invasion route and
allow themselves to be
captured by Karlyn.
<font color=blue>Tika</font>: Got it! I'll do my best!
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font>: Ugh... I'm still against\nthis. It's far too dangerous...
<font color=blue>Welch</font>: Then just make sure\nyou protect her properly. I told\nyou to steel yourself!

<font color=blue>Coro</font>: Euwin, I want you to
proudly announce that you are
a member of the Rakstar
family and cause a fair bit of
chaos.

Valka, please operate in a way
that prevents heavy casualties
on both sides, and let me know
if you determine the risk has
become too great.
I will then teleport you to\nsafety.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Leave it to me. I've been
caught up in things like this a
few times before, so I'll handle
it.
<font color=blue>Valka</font> I understand... Ugh... I\nwonder if I can do this...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> You'll be fine, you'll be\nfine.
Valka is strong. If you just stay\ncalm and do what you always\ndo, you're invincible.
It'll be okay, it'll be okay.
<font color=blue>Valka</font> Y-yeah, thanks, Verda.\nI'll... I'll do my best!
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I'm nervous!

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Uh, let's see... Once we
get the signal to retreat from
Henri, we'll head toward
Conroy's side...

We'll use transport descent to
scatter flyers toward Conroy's
side, stating that Ewin Laxter
and Tika Blanche have been
captured.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Yeah, well, I'll just let my\nfather and brothers deal with\nthe fallout in the royal capital.
I can just apologize to my\nsister later.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> After that, Rekoro, Valka,\nand Henri will provide frequent,\ndetailed updates...
We will also keep a close watch\non the Imperial Capital for any\nsuspicious activity.

If the masked man appears
before any anomalies occur in
the Imperial Capital, the plan is
a success. Otherwise, it's a
failure, and we'll have to think
of our next move.

<font color=blue>Evelysse</font>: In the meantime, we'll
continue to put all our efforts
into searching for the Holy
Land.
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en: <font color=blue>Valka</font>: Captain. Separately,\nthere is something else I want\nyou to continue investigating.
<font color=blue>Valka</font>: The search for the\nentity that brought down my\nship. I simply cannot let it go.
<font color=blue>Coro</font>: But... we've already been\nover this so many times...
<font color=blue>Valka</font>: In this sector of space,\nthings happen that defy all\ncommon sense.

The dungeons beneath the
capital of Rubarika, Baschen's
Imperial Castle, the masked
man, and the Holy Land of
Asyl.
There are already this many\nthings that Administrator\nKoro's sensors cannot detect.
Just because we can't see\nanything now doesn't mean it\ndoesn't exist.
<font color=blue>Coro</font>: Ugh... w-well, that's true...

<font color=blue>Valka</font>: Nothing happened during
the trips between Daftine and
Daftes. However, that doesn't
mean it will always be that way.

I don't want to be alone ever
again, and more than anything,
I want to ensure Miss Tika's
future safety.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font>: Coro! Captain! Did you
hear that?! We shall continue
the investigation! For Tika's
safety!

<font color=blue>Coro</font>: I get it, I get it! I'll do it,
I'll do it! On my honor as a
Koken, I'll even find out why
Valka's ship went down!
<font color=blue>Valka</font>: ...I'm counting on you.
<font color=blue>Coro</font>: Right! Now, is everyone\nready?!
First, Tika, Rekoro, Euwin, and\nValka, please prepare for\nteleport descent!
Right! Well then, Welch.
Yeah, yeah.
We're heading out.
Mm! Take care.
Now then! I wonder what I\nshould take apart first...
...Wait, what?
True. Those two are just...
It feels as if they've already\nreached perfection...

What? What are you talking
about? It's incredibly annoying
that you're all looking at me
with those pitying eyes! What
is it!
...Nothin' at all...
Anyway, while we search for\nAsyl,

let's focus on what needs to
be done so we can be notified
immediately if the Baschen
Imperial Capital makes any
strange moves!
Wow, this is amazing! I can't\nbelieve we could travel to a\nplace like this in an instant!

Your first teleportation can be
nerve-wracking. I remember
being really anxious when I first
did it.

I guess it's a common thing in
the future where Tika is from.
If this kind of technology were
common, carriages and ships
would just disappear.

Surprisingly, that is not the
case. While they are no longer
the mainstream of logistics,
carriages and seafaring ships
still exist.
I'd love to see it. A world that\nincredible...!
This is no time to be giddy.
Let's assess the situation. I'll\nbring up the map now.
Valka's gadget is amazing too!\nGlowing pictures and maps\nfloating in mid-air!
D-don't... I-I don't get anything\nout of being praised! Ehe,\nehehehe...
...I am uneasy.
R-right, so, uh, let's see...
Hmm, okay, this is the location\nof the communicator held by\nMista Henri.

Big sister Valka is so much
cuter when she's smiling. I
wonder why she always talks
like that.
I'm uneasy...

Baschen's Conroy conquest
force is slowly heading our
way, so we'll eventually
encounter them even if we just
stand here,

but considering the location of
Conroy Village, the amount of
damage to the village will likely
depend on where the battle
takes place.
I see. If this dot represents\nus...
Maybe here? This would\nensure Conroy doesn't take\nany damage at all.

I agree. Not only the village,
but I also don't want any
casualties among Baschen's
conquest force,
or Mista Henri's kin, who have\nlikely been summoned by the\nBeast Witch.

If we fight here, we can force
the Conroy conquest force to
retreat before Rubarika's
defense force in Conroy even
arrives, even if things get
chaotic.
All right, let's go. Tika, Rekoro.
Yeah!
...I will do everything in my\npower to keep Tika safe.

Now, I'll activate my optical
camouflage. Even if you can't
see me, I'll be right by your
side. Please, proceed with
confidence.
W-wow, she's actually invisible...\nThat's amazing, Valka!
...I-I told you, praising me isn't\ngoing to get you anything!
Big sister Valka!? You're\nturning a little red!
I'm getting anxious!
Hold it! Stop right there!
You lot must be the force\nattacking Baschen! I won't let\nyou push further into Conroy!
If you're determined to go,\nyou'll have to defeat me first!

Get through me first! I am
Ewin Laxter, son of the
Rakstar family, lords of
Carlone!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Ewin: "

en: Big brother Euwin is so cool!
...Is he, really?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Rekoro & Valca: "

en: And for that matter, this girl is\nthe one General Ricardo Franz\nis paying 100,000 phor to find!
If you keep invading Conroy,\nGeneral Ricardo won't just\nstand by and watch!!
Big brother Euwin is so cool!
I'm not so sure\nabout that...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Rekoro & Valca: "

en: Couldn't he have handled that...\nI don't know, a bit better?
He's got spirit, and that's what\nmatters.

What happened to his usual
seasoned traveler vibe, or his
knack for negotiation and
manipulation? Why is he acting
like that?

I imagine there's a big
difference in his mind between
the art of "making a lie seem
real" and simply "acting."
If Welch were here, she'd tease\nhim for his wooden acting for\nthe rest of his life... *Sigh*.
All units, halt!

I don't quite get what's going
on, but if they really are
connected to the Rakstar
family or Ricardo Franz, we
can't let them go! Capture
them alive!
Y-yes,\nma'am...!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Baschen Soldier: "

en: Uh, anyway,\nattack!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en: Waaaaagh! Come and get\nsome! Hyaaaaah!!
He's certainly full of energy.
Honestly...
Hyaaaaaaaah!!
Now! Take them down!
Grrrrrrr-woooo!!
Whoa! What's with this wolf?!\nDammit! I'm beat!
Big brother! Help meeee!
I shall say no more...
...Ugh! Honestly, now...!
It seems it's true that he is a\nmember of the Rakstar family.
This boy's face also matches\nthe wanted posters circulating\nwithin Rubarika.
Retreat for now! We're\nchanging tactics to make use\nof this hostage!
Dammit! Where do you think\nyou're taking us?!
Help meeee!
Will you both just shut up\nalready!
Eh.
Ah, right.
Good grief...
I can't believe they retreated\nto Korurine Village...
I wonder if the villagers who\ngot caught up in the fighting\nback then are okay...

From what I've heard,
unfortunately, there were a fair
number of casualties in the
battle you were involved in
here.
The survivors evacuated to the\nImperial Capital, and now only\nsoldiers remain.
...I see.

Therefore, Karlyn's message is
for both of you to stop the
unnecessary acting and just
stay captured quietly.
Was there something wrong\nwith our acting?
...I'll warn you that it was\nnothing but problematic.
But we tried our best...
I didn't think it was that bad.\nValka? Are you there? What\ndid you think?
...I'm here. Sorry, but honestly...\nuh... well... sorry, I can't\ncomment on that.
What?!
I-I think you were really cool,\nBig Brother Euwin! You did\ngreat, right?!
Tika. Is turning a blind eye to\nthe truth not contrary to the\npurpose of this journey?

Now, now, that's enough from
everyone. Regardless, we'll wait
here until that problematic
masked man appears.

<font color=blue>Henri</font> Since I am the beast that
Karlyn summoned, I cannot
stay here for long. Valka, I
leave the two of them to you.
<font color=blue>Valka</font> Leave it to me.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Will things be alright\nback in the Imperial Capital?
If word gets out that Karlyn is\nleading a unit on her own, Givel\nwill be here in no time...

<font color=blue>Henri</font> Regarding that, it seems
Commander-in-Chief Givel has
headed to the battlefield by
the sea.

It appears that Rubarika's
"Messenger of Daftes" has
taken direct command, and
they've begun fighting for
control of the waters where
Asyl is expected to appear.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> ...So it's finally\nhappening.

<font color=blue>Tika</font> The messenger from
Rubarika... that's the person
Big Brother Euwin mentioned
back in the Royal Capital,
right?
The one who appointed General\nRicardo...
I wonder if they're scary, like\nthat Givel person.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> I told you, they say
General Ricardo himself is the
power of the emissary. Unlike
Givel, I've hardly heard any
rumors about them.
All I know about Rubarika's\n"Emissary of Daftes" is that\ntheir name is <font color=yellow>Elaine</font>.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> What?
What's wrong?

O-oh, nothing. It's just that
Elaine is the same name as my
mother's, so I was a little
surprised.

...I wonder if there's a
connection. After everything
that's happened, I'm starting to
think everything is a sign.

Maybe Tika's mother also
ended up in this era in some
strange way because of the
accident Tika encountered in
the future.

But my mom is just a regular
housewife. Even if she came to
the past, she couldn't spread
technology like the "Emissary's
Light Arrow."

And she's not close with
General Ricardo. My mom gets
really nervous around people
like that... so I don't think that's
it.
Hahaha, when a child puts you\nin your place like that, there's\nno arguing.
But... she's such a kind mother.
If she's safe, I don't want her\nto be in a place like this. I'm\nsure she'd be terrified.
That may not be the case.
Huh?
It seems that parents can\novercome any hardship when it\ncomes to their children.

Perhaps your mother is
embarking on a journey across
time specifically to save you,
Miss Tika.
...Do you... really think so?
I'd be so happy if I could find\nher somewhere...

If this "Messenger" named
Elaine is indeed connected to
you, Tika, we will eventually
cross paths.
If she is your mother, you\nshould give her a big hug when\nyou do.

And if she isn't... then you
simply continue moving forward
for the sake of future peace,
just as you have been.
We are here for you. There is\nnothing to be afraid of.
...Yeah. You're right... thank you.

First, we must bring the Holy
War to an end. Let us move
forward toward that goal
without wavering.
And for now, let us patiently\nawait the appearance of this\n"Masked Man" you speak of.
It's been three days already,\nand there's still no sign of that\nmasked man.

He's only appeared within
Rubarika's territory so far, so
maybe it'll take a bit longer for
him to show up in Baschen's
territory.
Whoops. Mmm... alright.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Go ahead.
<font color=blue>Henri</font> Grrr...

<font color=blue>Beast Witch</font> Excuse me! Orders
have arrived from the Imperial
Capital for each of the
front-line units!
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Orders? May I see\nthem?
<font color=blue>Henri</font> Grrr...?
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> ...A new unit is coming\nfrom the Imperial Capital?

<font color=blue>Beast Witch</font> Yes. Apparently,
it's to gain an advantage in the
land battles now that Lord
Givel has moved to command
the navy...
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I see. When is this new\nunit expected to arrive here in\nKorurine?

<font color=blue>Beast Witch</font> Well, the thing is,
Lord Givel's orders only stated
that they would appear when
the time is right. No march plan
or anything of the sort was
included.

<font color=blue>Beast Witch</font> ...Um, Lady Karlyn.
Are you sure it's alright not to
notify the Imperial Capital that
you've returned?

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> I will not bother Lord
Givel with trivial reports while
he is occupied fighting
Rubarika's "emissaries." I shall
report when it becomes
necessary.
Just keep me informed of\nevery detail regarding this new\nunit... You may leave.
<font color=blue>Beast Witch</font> Y... Yes, excuse\nme.

<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> A new unit from the
Imperial Capital... I wonder if
Tika's plan was too naive after
all.
<font color=blue>Henri</font> Grrr... If worst comes to\nworst, we still have the\nteleportation containment.

Neither Valka nor I have
received any special
communication from the
captains. Waiting until the last
possible moment shouldn't be a
problem...
Hm.

E-excuse me! I've
received a report from the
guards on perimeter watch
that there are intruders in
Korurine!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en: Grrr...!

Also, I am terribly
sorry! We've currently lost
sight of the intruders! T-that
shouldn't even be possible...!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en:
A-anyway, there's
a possibility that Rubarika
soldiers have sneaked into the
village of Korurine! I will handle
Lady Karlyn's escort...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en: ...Sigh.
Lady Karlyn!?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en:
I'll be fine. I already have a
perfectly capable guard here,
so you go help search for that
intruder.
I'm not someone who can be\ntaken down by a mere\nRubarika soldier.
Now, go!
Y-yes, ma'am!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en: ...Speak of the devil.
Well then, shall we begin\npreparations for withdrawal?
He... he actually came...

You... you little
brat, Rakstar! You've got some
nerve pulling a stunt like that!
Thanks to you lot, everything's
been thrown into chaos!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: That was the plan.
It was my idea! Big brother\nEuwin didn't do anything wrong!

note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: We just wanted to see you.
We didn't have any other\nchoice! Please, just listen to us!

...Still, why did
you have to bring me to a
place this heavily guarded...
Dammit!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Please. I want to ask you about\nthe collar you used on Sister\nKarlyn.
There's a place we want you to\ngo with us...
Fine, fine. I'll tell\nyou what I can. But not here!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
Hey! You woman
hiding there with the weapon!
Stop sneaking around and
show yourself!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: You really think\nyou're hidden with that\npathetic excuse for a cloak!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: What!?
What!?
H-he can see through my\ninvisibility!?

I've got a pretty
good idea of what you lot are
up to! Anyway, let's just get
Tika out of here already!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Um... how do you know who I\nam? And why are you trying to\nprotect me?
...You really have\nno clue, do you?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Huh?
Never mind. Let's\njust get out of here.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
Hey, Rakstar, you
brat! Where are Karlyn Kayson
and that werewolf Daftes!
They're nearby, right!?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Wait! How do you know about\nHenri too?
There's no way you've ever\nmet Henri...
I told you we'll\ntalk later!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Listen! Everything\nI have is borrowed!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
The mechanism
of the Witch's Collar, the
Symbology inside―I don't
understand a single thing
about it! It's all borrowed!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Damn it, I'm not\nletting myself get tripped up\nhere!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
Hey, you
listening, Coro! You piece of
junk AI! Get everyone aboard
the ship, now!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Huh!? H-how do you know my\nname...!?
Who on earth are you...!
Hm... what is this! An abnormal\nSymbology reaction is\napproaching!

Detecting the approach of a
lifeform containing immense
Symbology power! Coro! Initiate
transport and containment!
Ah, uh, um... wait!?\nS-something's wrong! I can't\nlock onto any of you!
Damn, just as I\nthought... Here it comes!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Ah... aaaaaah...
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en: Is that... the Beast Witch?
Something's wrong with her!
Aaaaaaaaaah!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Beast Witch: "

en: Damn it... that\npiece of junk AI!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Who on earth is that... is she\nanother "Beast of Baschen"\ntoo!?
Don't be stupid.\nThere's no way a "Beast" like\nthat exists... We're leaving!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: What!?

If you mess
around with her, you'll end up
with more than just a few
scratches! First, we regroup
with that witch! Until then,
protect Tika with your life!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Tika! You're safe!
Oh, good! You're safe too,\nKarlyn! I'm so glad!
Euwin! Valka! Rekoro! I see\nyou've successfully linked up\nwith the masked man!

The village is in terrible shape.
Those six-winged creatures
appeared out of nowhere and
started rampaging; we can't
get them under control!
We saw them! Those are the\nforms the Beast Witches took\nwhen they transformed!
W-what did you say!?
We saw the witches transform!

I don't care about
that! You've come all this way
and you still can't contain
them!?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
Well, the thing is, when the
witches transformed, the
teleportation signals went
completely haywire...
Hey, Coro! What are you doing\nwhile Eu and the others are in\ndanger!?
I'll go! Let me down right now!
Hyaaaa!? Ms. Welch, please\nstop messing with the controls!

Welch Vineyard!
Don't come over here, you'll
only make things more
troublesome!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Hey, witch! How\nmany Beast Witches were\nstationed in this village!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
T-there shouldn't be ten... But,
but what on earth is that...
What happened to those
children?

The Crown Prince
of Baschen wanted new power
from that idiot Givel to destroy
Rubarika.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: That bastard\nGivel accepted it and deployed\nthem to the Rubarika front.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
That's what I've
heard... You probably received
an order saying a new unit was
being formed, right?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: I did receive one... but you're\nsaying this is what it was for!?
When the time comes... the\nBeast Witches... turned into\nthose things...
Why, why would anyone do\nthis!!
This Givel... to treat not only\nmy kin, but the people of this\nland as mere pawns...
He seems to be a far more\ndangerous individual than the\nrumors suggested.
That doesn't matter right now!\nHow are we going to ensure\nTika's safety!

...You're Rekoro,
right? I've got some bad news.
If you want them teleported
back, your only choice is to
wipe out those witches who've
turned into monsters.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: What...!

Apparently, the
Gem power they're emitting is
warping space. The only way to
stop it is to take out the
source.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Isn't there any way to save\nthem!?
Once they're like\nthat, there's nothing left to do\nbut kill 'em.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
How much does Mista know
about the witches'
transformation? We cannot
fight effectively unless that
information is shared.
...They're called\n"Exorcisers," supposedly.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Exorcisers?

From what I've
heard, that's Givel's true
objective for intervening in the
Holy War.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en: Who... who are you? How do\nyou know all this?
What, Rakstar\nkid, you still haven't figured it\nout?
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Masked Man: "

en:
In Rubarika, I'm known as
Ricardo Franz. Though my true
name is something else
entirely.
You... you're General Ricardo?
...Why were you looking for me?
To protect your life.
I don't understand. How do you\nknow about me? I...
You came from the future. Am\nI right?
General Ricardo, you...!
If you want to know what lies\nahead, first you'll have to make\nit out of this village alive.
...Ooooooh...
Ugh... W-when did they get\nhere?!
Do we... do we really have to\nfight?!
If you want to reach the future,\nyou do! Here they come!
It seems we've managed to\nsurvive...
...I can't believe this... how could\nthis happen!!
Karlyn...

Unforgivable... absolutely
unforgivable! Giverese! To do
this to the witches... to the
people of the Fox Soul...!!
...Save that anger for a little\nlonger.

The ladder will descend soon.
When it does, you'll be forced
to face him whether you like it
or not.
What!? The ladder is\ndescending!?

Yeah. The real Holy War is
about to begin. Before that,
we're going to storm the Holy
Land Asyl before Rubarika or
Baschen can.
B-but how is that even\npossible...?
Asyl surfaces from the sea\nbefore the ladder even\ndescends.
What? I thought the ladder\nwas what summoned Asyl.

That's not entirely wrong. But
the folks from Rubarika and
Baschen just rely on
unscientific observations and
hearsay regarding the causality
of it all.
Apparently, once Asyl surfaces,\nit and the ladder exist in a\nstate of mutual resonance.
Either way, the brief window of\ntime that Asyl remains above\nthe sea...
That is the time we have to\nstop the Holy War.

Hey, you listening, Coro?! Get
us back up to the ship, now!
We're warping straight onto
Asyl!
...Feels like I'm not exactly\nwelcome here, huh?
If you actually thought you'd be\nwelcomed, you're way too\noptimistic.
Who on earth are you? You\nknow far too much about\neverything.
And you intend to keep that\nmask on even now?
My scans aren't working. That\nmask and armor... they aren't\nDaftine-made, are they?

I can tell just by looking that
the Kingdom army emblem you
possess is genuine. I am, after
all, a member of the nobility.

However, there are far too
many strange things about you.
You'll answer all of our
questions, won't you?
Good grief, they're really taking\nthis opportunity to grill me.
I'm not Tika's enemy. Shouldn't\nthat be enough for you\npeople?
Ugh, this is so complicated.
It is true that General Ricardo\ndid his utmost to defend Tika.
But that is a separate matter\nentirely.
Look, Tika is terrified.
Exactly! Exactly!

And while I agreed to the warp
transport due to the
emergency, normally we
wouldn't allow someone like you
on the ship...

What, you're saying I'm violating
Galactic Federation military
regulations and the Uncharted
Planet Protection Treaty?

You lot never change, always
clinging to the same old lines. I
couldn't care less about your
rules.
Huh!?
...Huh?
You know about the Galactic\nFederation?
What of it if I do? That's not\nwhat's important right now.
I told you Asyl is going to\nsurface. I assume you've been\nscanning the sea surface.
...Coro, Verda, and I have been\nkeeping watch this whole time.
Where are Rubarika and\nBaschen's naval forces?
They're probably right here on\nthe map.

Besides, who do you think you
are, bossing us around before
we've even had a chance to
speak?
...Damn it, this isn't how I heard\nit would go.
Did those Exorciser bastards\nget in the way on this end\ntoo?
At this rate, we won't be\nbuying much time...
Hm!
Ah, ahh! C-Captain! Look! Look\nover there!
Finally showing up, huh.
W-what is it, Coro!
That! That right there! Look at\nit!!
The sea... it's rising!
Something's coming out!
Th-this is...!
This is... the Holy Land of\nAsyl...!
Unbelievable... an island of this\nscale, rising from the depths of\nthe sea...!
...To think we spent hundreds\nof years... for something like\nthis...
...The movements of both\nnavies have shifted... The time\nfor the final battle draws near.
If we go there... we'll find the\ntruth.

Exactly. The Moonshadow
Ladder will descend soon. The
offensives from Rubarika and
Baschen will likely reach their
peak.
But there should still be a little\ntime before either army lands\non Asyl.
Hey, Ewin Laxter. You haven't\nforgotten what you said, have\nyou?
I'll do it!
I'm going to end this Holy Land\nWar, no matter what!
Daftine... doesn't need some\n"Holy Land"!
That's the spirit.

Now, we're going to tear that
Holy Land apart! Right in front
of the Rubarika and Baschen
armies!
